title: Business Process without target criticality (BIA missing)
cardHint: An Operational Business Process has no CIA values and no tag BIA N/A or BIA is pending. SACM checks the status or the tag.
cardText: Criticality starts on the Business Process: its CIA values come from the BIA, and the process becomes Operational after its mapping. A process in Ready without CIA values is not listed: it may wait there. An Operational (or Under retirement) process without CIA values is wrong, unless the tag BIA N/A or BIA is pending says why: SACM checks the status, or adds the tag. Nobody is written to: SACM does not chase the BIA.
